title: Native application menu (File/Edit/View/Window/Help)
intent: First-class native menu bar with roles, accelerators, and app actions; macOS app menu.
parityChecklist: macOS app menu (About/Preferences/Services/Hide/Quit) with correct roles
File menu (New window, Export…, Print snapshot, Close)
Edit menu with standard roles (undo/redo/cut/copy/paste/selectAll)
View menu (Reload, Toggle DevTools in dev only, Zoom, Fullscreen, Theme)
Window menu (Minimize/Zoom/Front) and Help (Docs, Report bug, Shortcuts)
Accelerators wired and forwarded to web routes/actions via IPC
All labels localized via Strings/*

title: Context menus (content + link + selection)
intent: Right-click context menus for copy, open-link-externally, inspect (dev), and route actions.
parityChecklist: Selection context menu (copy)
Link context menu (open externally, copy link)
Editable field context menu (cut/copy/paste/select all)
Inspect element only in dev builds
Localized labels

title: System tray icon + quick actions
intent: Tray presence with status, show/hide, and quick navigation actions.
parityChecklist: Tray icon (theme-aware / template image on macOS) with tooltip
Context menu: Show/Hide app, Active vehicle, Quick routes, Quit
Click toggles window visibility (platform-correct behavior)
Live status reflected in tooltip/title (e.g. charging)
Localized labels

title: Dock / taskbar badge, progress, and overlay
intent: Surface notification counts and long-task progress on the dock/taskbar.
parityChecklist: Unread notification count → dock badge (macOS) / taskbar overlay (Windows)
Background work progress → setProgressBar
Badge clears when notifications are read
Count sourced from the same hook the web bell uses

title: Native OS notifications bridged from web events
intent: Web Notification events become real OS notifications; clicking routes into the app.
parityChecklist: Web notification/alert events forwarded over IPC to main
Native Notification with title/body/icon/actions
Click → focus window + navigate to the relevant route
Respect OS Do-Not-Disturb / focus assist
Localized notification strings

title: Windows jump list / macOS dock menu (recent + tasks)
intent: Quick tasks and recent routes from the taskbar/dock without opening the app first.
parityChecklist: Windows JumpList Tasks (New window, Dashboard, Charging, Settings)
macOS app.dock.setMenu with the same quick tasks
Recent vehicles/routes category populated from app state

Localized labels

title: Auto-update UI (available / downloading / ready)
intent: User-facing update flow surfaced in desktop chrome; restart-to-apply.
parityChecklist: electron-updater events surfaced (checking/available/progress/downloaded/error)
In-app banner/toast offering Restart to update
Manual 'Check for updates' menu action
Defer/snooze option
Localized strings; version shown matches VersionSegment

title: Title bar / window controls (mac traffic lights, win controls overlay)
intent: Native-feeling title bar consistent with the web header, per OS conventions.
parityChecklist: macOS hidden-inset title bar with traffic-light positioning
Windows titleBarOverlay (controls overlay) with theme colors
Draggable region + non-drag interactive zones defined
Double-click maximize and OS window menu still work
Title reflects active page (matches web page title)

title: Global shortcuts + command palette bridge
intent: System-wide shortcuts (show/hide, quick capture) and Ctrl/Cmd+K parity.
parityChecklist: globalShortcut to show/hide the app (configurable, conflict-safe)
Ctrl/Cmd+K focuses the window and opens the web command palette
Shortcuts unregistered on quit
User-configurable + disable option

title: Power monitor (suspend/resume) handling
intent: Pause live work on sleep, resume on wake, to save battery and avoid stale state.
parityChecklist: powerMonitor suspend → pause SSE + polling
resume → reconnect SSE + refetch
lock-screen/unlock handled where relevant
Forwarded to renderer so the UI shows a reconnecting state

intent: Web export/download actions use native Save dialogs and write real files.
parityChecklist: Export (CSV/PDF/JSON) routed through dialog.showSaveDialog
File written to the chosen path with correct mime/extension
Open-containing-folder / reveal-in-finder affordance
Errors surfaced in-app
Localized dialog titles/buttons

title: Native print snapshot
intent: The web 'Print snapshot' toolbar action uses native print/printToPDF.
parityChecklist: webContents.print with the native print dialog
printToPDF path with a native save dialog
Print-friendly styling preserved
Errors surfaced in-app

title: Native About panel + licenses
intent: Native About with version, build, and third-party licenses.
parityChecklist: app.setAboutPanelOptions (mac) + custom About window (win/linux)
Version/build/commit shown (matches VersionSegment)
Third-party license list bundled
Localized

title: Offline / reconnect detection in desktop chrome
intent: Detect network/online state at the OS level and surface a reconnect banner.
parityChecklist: net.isOnline / reachability of the API origin monitored
Offline → in-app banner; online → auto-clear + refetch
